text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — high error rate on /v1/generate from hosted cluster eu-west-1 (inc-2026-03-15-01). Trigger: 5xx > 2% for 10m.

maria: I'm on it. Confirming impact: dashboards show 20-30% error responses for ~15m. Page sent to @sam. @support-bot can you queue customer-facing blurb draft?

sam: Acknowledged. Diving in. Can someone run quick health checks on pods? `kubectl get pods -n redwood-eu --selector=app=inference`

julian: I ran them — 3 replicas reporting CrashLoopBackOff on model-host-3-*. Logs show OOM in the runtime: `cuda out of memory` after model load.

maria: Likely regression from last retry batching patch. Rolling back canary to previous image. @ops-rotation please prepare canary rollback steps.

ops-rotation: rollbacks ready: `deployment set image inference=redwood/inference:20260210` then `/bin/restart-svc`. I'll execute on approval.

sam: Do it. Also starting immediate mitigation: scale up buffer nodes and reduce max_batch_size to 8 for canary.

incident-bot: Action logged: rollback started by ops-rotation. ETA 4m.

maria: Updating status page draft (public). Support, please use the Intercom/Zendesk macro below for inbound tickets.

support-bot: Draft macros below. Use exact copy-paste. Keep customer-specific tokens `{{customer_name}}` / `{{org_id}}`.

support-bot: Zendesk macro (short):
```
We’re aware of increased errors affecting inference requests in EU regions. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue. We expect service restoration within ~15 minutes. No action required on your side. We’ll send another update when normal operation resumes. — Redwood Inference Support
```

support-bot: Intercom canned reply (concise):
```
Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for reporting. We’re currently experiencing transient errors for inference requests in EU. Our team is rolling back a canary change and monitoring. We’ll follow up here once the issue is resolved. Apologies for the disruption.
```

support-bot: Internal escalation macro (Zendesk — to engineering):
```
PRIORITY: HIGH — Customer impact ongoing. Issue: 5xx errors on /v1/generate EU. Attached logs and request IDs. Please loop in runtime-eng and infra oncall. Requesting ETA and mitigation plan.
```

julian: For agents: quick troubleshooting checklist to triage tickets >= 1% error rate:
- Check status.redwood.ai for region status
- Confirm customer's org_id and timestamp of failed request
- Search logs for request IDs or correlation IDs
- If 5xx validated, escalate with internal macro above

leo: Status page suggested public messages — pick one depending on stage:
1) Investigating: "We are investigating increased error rates for inference requests in EU-West. Engineers are actively assessing the impact."
2) Identified: "We’ve identified a runtime OOM regression affecting some inference hosts in EU-West and are rolling back the recent canary."
3) Mitigated: "A rollback has been applied and traffic is recovering. We continue to monitor."

maria: Posting now: set status to "Identified" with note 2. Also starting a brief internal incident note for execs. Draft below — copy into #incidents-brief when ready.

maria: Exec brief draft:
```
Impact: ~20-30% of inference requests to eu-west returned 5xx between 11:04–11:22 UTC. Root cause: OOM regression from batching change deployed in canary. Mitigation: rolled back canary image and scaled buffer nodes; requests returning to normal. Customer impact: transient errors; no data loss. Next steps: follow-up RCA, revert or fix batching change, add safer rollout gating.
```

support-bot: Reminder for agents: use 'public status' snippet for forum/social posts and keep tone short + actionable.

sam: Rollback finished, going to monitor. Initial metrics show error rate dropping to <1% within 3m. CPU and GPU memory look stable.

incident-bot: Update — service partially restored. Error rate fell to 0.8% in eu-west; continuing to observe.

maria: Great. Support, please start closing tickets with the 'mitigated' macro and update customers who reported actively.

support-bot: Closing macro for Zendesk:
```
Update: The issue affecting inference requests in EU-West has been mitigated. Services are recovering; if you still see errors, reply and we’ll investigate further. Thank you for your patience. — Redwood Inference Support
```

julian: Post-incident checklist for SRE / support:
- Collect logs and heap dumps from affected hosts
- Save rollout artifacts (images, configs)
- File RCA and link to incident thread
- Add automated gating for batch-size changes in canary

maria: I'll hand off to @julian for postmortem. Sam — you can hand off active monitoring to the night oncall.

sam: Handing off to julian. I’ll leave a short note in #oncall-handoffs with current metrics and runbook pointer.

leo: Thanks everyone. Quick note: update the Zendesk macro in KB to include the status page link and incident ID when available.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 11:50 UTC by maria. Duration ~46m.

maria: Thanks all. Filing RCA doc and follow-up actions. Closing thread.

support-bot: Action items for support team: update macros, runthrough checklist in next shift, and prepare canned CS follow-ups for impacted enterprise customers.
